evidence: Modifies public interfaces in src/interfaces/wallet.h, src/interfaces/chain.h, and src/interfaces/node.h to propagate broadcast errors across process boundaries.
rationale: Extends node and wallet interface methods to return structured broadcast errors needed by multiprocess consumers like the QML GUI. The PR description notes that frontends relying on `interfaces::Wallet::commitTransaction` could not detect rejected transactions because the method returned `void`, unblocking gui-qml#1008.
